metadata.title: How to Browse Albums in Melivra | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
To browse your music by album in Melivra, use the Albums view in Library. Identify an album by its title and cover, then check the track count and total duration shown below it.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator screenshot with original demonstration titles, procedural cover art and silent audio fixtures. The screen remains stationary; no taps, playback, import, save result, or speed demonstration is shown. Displayed times belong to the demo library.

Explore Melivra for Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.melivra
